data.title: Unit 8: Matter and changing matter
Matter and particles
data.heading: Matter and particles
data.text: All matter is made of tiny particles called atom.
The central of the atom is called nucleus.
The nucleus contains protons and neutrons.
The electrons are particles that orbit the nucleus.
When two or more atoms join together, they form a molecule.
The molecules in a solid are packed tightly and can't move.
The molecules in a liquid have enough space to move around.
The molecules in a gas are very loosely packed.
